name: Kirari
source:
An air-headed gal who is cheerful and friendly with everyone. This includes the protagonist, who is at the bottom of the caste system. She hates bullying and intervenes whenever she cans.

Despite her slutty style, she is still a virgin. But she's still interested in sex and eagerly awaits finding someone to make love with. Due to this, she is a shameless flirt.
